description: Choose whether this Space appears in the public directory: unlisted (default, hidden), listed (shown; join requests land here for a member to accept) or open (shown; anyone who asks is admitted at once). Members are told. Needs invite rights. Idempotent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A string you generate once per intended action (a UUID is good) and repeat on retry. A retry with the same key and arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice; the same key with different arguments is refused. Kept 24 hours.

name: set_listing
title: List this Space
